scope: Explicit image-plane Gaussian/analytic camera studies from real generated scene programs.
qualityCaveat: Format, exact evaluator inputs, complete frame counts and temporal differences are measured. The camera represents inferred depth-layer parallax; it does not establish ground-truth hidden geometry or photorealism.

results.title: 米白墙面与晨间行人灯

firstFrameCodecFidelity.scope: Lossy H.264 first decoded frame versus the exact native source frame, only inside the content viewport; black padding excluded.

encoding.colorConversion: Full-range gamma-encoded sRGB → BT.709 YCbCr limited range; sRGB transfer retained and tagged. Frame-level setparams metadata is set after conversion as well as encoder flags.

temporalDiagnostic.definition: Absolute RGB byte differences between consecutive uncompressed rendered frames; contains intended camera motion, disocclusion and sampling changes. It is not a motion-compensated flicker score.
temporalDiagnostic.borderDomain: Edge of the native content viewport, excluding black padding.
